meta.name: sap-spartacus-contentstack-mapping-registry
changelog: 0.3.0 — Navigation activated with the FLAT (adjacency-list) model: recursive navigation/navigation_node replaced by nav_node_flat (parent_id text + sort_order) + category_navigation_flat/footer_navigation_flat (all_nodes pool). Category/FooterNavigationComponent now route to the flat types instead of passthrough. Kills the Delivery API include-depth cap that truncated deep menus; verified end-to-end with the Spartacus connector.

0.2.1 — Phase 3b live-seed corrections against a real NA stack: rich_text.content is HTML advanced RTE (not JSON RTE); passthrough_component.config is multiline text holding JSON (Contentstack has no generic json field); enum fields carry display_type:dropdown.

0.2.0 — Phase 2: storefront-extract layout sampling surfaced 5 product/category-page functional typeCodes (BundleCarouselComponent, CMSProductListComponent, CMSTabParagraphContainer, ProductAddToCartComponent, ProductReferencesComponent); all mapped to passthrough_component. Navigation node tree now captured by the extractor but content types remain _active:false (deferred).
0.1.0 — initial: spine + authored types + passthrough, from content-page crawl of electronics-spa and powertools-spa.
meta.description: Authoritative mapping from SAP Commerce CMS component typeCodes to Contentstack content types, plus the fixed structural spine. Consumed by the content-model and cs-seed skills. Extended ~1 entry per new storefront via Gate 1.

conventions.underscore_keys: Any key prefixed with `_` (e.g. _source, _note, _round_trip) is registry metadata and is stripped by cs-seed before calling the Contentstack Management API.
conventions.upsert_keys: Idempotent seeding upserts by these unique fields: cms_page.page_label, cms_content_slot.slot_id, every component type.sap_meta.sap_uid.
conventions.ordering: Contentstack multiple reference and group fields preserve authored order; SAP slot/component order is captured 1:1.
conventions.class: authored = content managers edit it (full schema). functional = code/commerce-driven, no authored content (passthrough). structural = the page/slot spine.

sap_component_base.title: SAP Component Base
sap_component_base._note: Included as a global_field in every component content type so uid/name/typeCode/container are captured uniformly. type_code is what the connector reads to decide which OCC component shape to emit on round-trip.

schema._note: ordered; binds a template position to a slot entry

cms_content_slot.title: CMS Content Slot
cms_content_slot._note: Shared/global slots (header, footer, nav) are ordinary entries with shared=true, referenced by many pages. No separate 'global slot' type is needed.

schema._note: true => global slot reused across pages
ordered list of component entries of any ACTIVE component content type. 'navigation' is deferred to v0.2 and re-added here when activated.

banner.title: Banner
banner._round_trip: type_code=SimpleResponsiveBannerComponent -> emit media{mobile,tablet,desktop,widescreen}; type_code=SimpleBannerComponent -> emit single media (desktop asset) + external flag.

rich_text.title: Rich Text
rich_text._round_trip: connector emits component.content directly from the HTML RTE value. Round-trip diff normalizes HTML (whitespace, attribute order) before comparing.
rich_text._decision: RESOLVED (v0.2.1): HTML-based advanced RTE (data_type text + allow_rich_text). Stores OCC HTML directly, so seed/deliver need no HTML<->JSON conversion. Chosen over JSON RTE after the live seed: Contentstack rejects a generic json field here and HTML RTE round-trips losslessly.

schema._note: HTML advanced RTE; stores OCC HTML verbatim

link.title: Link
link._round_trip: emit linkName, url OR contentPage/contentPageLabelOrId, target, external, styleClasses.

schema._note: optional: links to a page id instead of a raw url

product_carousel.title: Product Carousel
product_carousel._round_trip: join product_codes with a single space -> component.productCodes.
product_carousel._note: product_codes reference commerce records that stay in the commerce backend; we only store the codes, not the products.

merchandising_carousel.title: Merchandising Carousel
merchandising_carousel._note: Personalized carousel driven by a merchandising strategy id (SAP CDS). Only seen on electronics-spa. Content managers set title/strategy/display config.

nav_node_flat.title: Nav Node (Flat)
nav_node_flat._note: Flat adjacency-list nav node. parent_id is PLAIN TEXT (the parent's node_id, NOT a reference), so the hierarchy costs zero reference-resolution depth; sort_order orders siblings. Every node of a menu lives in one all_nodes pool on the component and the connector rebuilds the tree in code — so menu depth never hits the Delivery API's plan-gated include-depth cap. Replaces the recursive navigation_node.

schema._source: navigationNode.title, else resolved link_name for titleless SAP leaf nodes

category_navigation_flat.title: Category Navigation (Flat)
category_navigation_flat._round_trip: emit wrapAfter + all_nodes (the flat pool of every node in the tree, all levels).
category_navigation_flat._note: Header/category nav, flat model. all_nodes references every nav_node_flat of the menu; the tree is rebuilt from each node's parent_id. One shallow, constant include chain regardless of depth.

footer_navigation_flat.title: Footer Navigation (Flat)
footer_navigation_flat._round_trip: emit wrapAfter + all_nodes (same shape as category_navigation_flat).
footer_navigation_flat._note: Footer nav, flat model. Same shape as category_navigation_flat; SAP footer notice/showLanguageCurrency are not carried (the footer renderer does not use them).

passthrough_component.title: Passthrough Component
passthrough_component._note: Catch-all for code/commerce-driven components with no authored content. Preserves typeCode + all remaining fields verbatim so NOTHING is lost and round-trip is exact. Also the safe landing spot for any brand-new typeCode before it earns a dedicated type via Gate 1.
passthrough_component._round_trip: emit type_code + spread config{} back as the component's fields.

schema._note: JSON-encoded verbatim map of every non-base field (CS has no generic json field; also holds the deferred navigationNode tree)

typecode_index._note: Every typeCode observed across the seeded sites, its target CS content type, and its class. New storefronts add rows here via Gate 1.

FooterNavigationComponent._note: flat model: nav tree flattened into nav_node_flat pool (all_nodes)

CategoryNavigationComponent._note: flat model: nav tree flattened into nav_node_flat pool (all_nodes)
